idle: Big days, dull days, both count. Nothing’s graded.

welcomeBack: The jar kept your place. Just today’s three, no catching up.
newMonth: October starts empty, on purpose. First star?

1: Two more and the lid pops.
2: One more and the lid pops. Keep typing, the star can land on its own.

today.done_line: {Weekday}’s folded and kept. Tomorrow asks about {Next}.
today.bonus_line: {Category} is in the jar too. {Next} is next if you want it.
today.enter_hint: folds a line into a star

review.title: All eight, if you’re up for it.
review.note: No rush. Fill what you can; the rest waits until Sunday night, no questions asked.
review.writing_hint: folds it; the last Enter moves to the next card.

shelf.title: Shelf
shelf.drag_hint: Drag the shelf. Tap a jar to pour it out.

panel.confirm: Take this star out of the jar?
panel.confirm_sub: It won’t come back. The day keeps its others.
panel.todays: Folded today, so it changes on Today.

shake.title: Shake for a memory
shake.sub: One star tumbles out. Could be last week, could be last spring.
shake.alt: or give your phone a gentle shake

insights.title: Insights
insights.sub: What your jar says about you (lovingly).
insights.early: Patterns need a couple of weeks of stars. So far {Category} leads with {n}.

settings.title: Settings

Sound: Paper, glass and one small chime, all in one key.
Quiet by default, and silent until you touch something.
Night and motion: Calmer swaps flights and wobbles for quick fades. The jar still fills, the lid still pops.
Keys: Your passkeys open your jar on your devices.
For a password manager other than {Provider}.
Your jar: They’re safe on this {device}, and go into your jar when you’re back online.
All {n} stars as plain text, yours to keep.
every star goes; your keys stay

empty_dialog.title: Empty the whole jar?
empty_dialog.body: All {n} stars and {j} jars go for good, on every device. Your keys stay. There’s no undo, so save a copy first if you might want them.
empty_dialog.done_body: {n} stars let go. Start again whenever you like: one small thing is plenty.

toasts: Saved a copy: {n} stars, as a text file
Calmer: quick fades instead of flights

ask: Right now it lives on this {device} only. Keep it, and one passkey opens it on all your devices.
One {Face ID}. No email, no password.
wait: Your {iPhone} asks for {Face ID} now. That makes a passkey: a key only your devices hold.
{Face ID} stays on this {device}. We never see it.
canceled: That’s fine. Your stars are still here on this {device}.
kept: Open it on {your other devices} with the same passkey. It’s saved in your {iCloud Keychain}.

hello.title: Good days are made of small things.
hello.lead: Three a day, folded into paper stars, in a jar only you can open.
hello.fine: Keeping one on another device? Its passkey opens it here.
wait: Your {iPhone} asks for {Face ID} now. Choose your Threefold passkey.
none: Nothing’s wrong with your jar. Try again.
Your passkey might live on another device. When your {iPhone} asks, you can choose to use a phone or tablet nearby.
opening: Pouring back in, from {j} jars. Everything you wrote, word for word.

passkey: The {Provider} passkey ({where}) won’t open your jar anymore. Your other keys still work.
last: Delete it and nothing could open your jar. Create another passkey first.
sign_out: Your stars stay safe in your jar. This {device} forgets them, and your passkey opens them again whenever you like.
signed_out: This {device} has forgotten your stars. They’re waiting in your jar, locked, for your passkey.
delete: All {n} stars, {j} jars and your passkeys go for good, on every device. There’s no undo, and no one can bring them back.
gone: Your jar, your stars and your keys are deleted from every device. Thank you for every small thing.

toasts: Your stars stay on this {device} for now.
Back online. {n} stars saved to your jar.
Back online. Everything’s in your jar.
Saved a copy of all {n} stars.
